The oldest writings are full of lament, not because lament is holy by itself, but because love that cannot lament becomes hard. Let the house be soft enough to cry.

Accountability remains. Mercy is not the cancellation of truth. It is the decision that truth will not be used as a knife at breakfast for the next twenty years.

An elder who has turned anger into protection does not become mild. The wall is still warm. What changes is the face it turns toward. It faces the street, not the cradle.

An elder's dignity is not the right to be obeyed in every small thing. It is the right to be respected while still listening. The listening is what makes the respect true.

Accountability begins when you can say, the heat was mine. Wisdom begins when you can say, it had a better door. Compassion begins when the person you nearly burned is still in the room, and you stay.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is amathambo, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 櫓 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Before the second loud sentence, step into the doorway, not toward the person. Let the heat guard the house from outside.

z: 櫔 amathambo, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Self-reflection is the moment you notice you needed to win. Accountability is saying so before you are forced. The turn from pride to dignity is mostly this small honesty.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is amathambo, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 櫔 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Kneel, or sit, so your eyes meet a child's. Stay there until the conversation is theirs.

z: 櫚 amathambo, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Siblings are assigned the same story and different gifts. Envy calls this injustice. Admiration calls it a house with more than one lamp. Both lamps belong on the table.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is amathambo, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 櫚 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Ask the person to show you how they did the thing. Be a student for ten minutes.

z: 櫛 amathambo, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
Many houses, under many names, give the same command: do not be ruled by dread, and do not despise the person who is. The strong are asked to stay, not to sneer.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is amathambo, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 櫛 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Hold the doorway. Let the frightened one see that you are not leaving.

z: 櫜 amathambo, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Hospitality is the oldest sociology of the lasting house. The stranger eats first. The family that cannot do this for a guest will eventually fail to do it for itself.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is amathambo, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 櫜 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Feed the guest, or the youngest, before you take your own share.

z: 櫝 amathambo, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Siblings remember the name they were called on the worst day. Do not give them that name. Give them the name of the good you have actually seen them do.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is amathambo, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 櫝 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Say the hard thing to the face, once, cleanly, with no audience.

z: 櫞 amathambo, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Children who are met with contempt learn to hide the clumsy part, which is most of them. Appreciation gives that part a chair.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is amathambo, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 櫞 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Remove the sneer from a sentence and speak it again. Notice how much of it was only the sneer.

z: 櫟 amathambo, maphakathi, ngakwesokudla
line:
The old practice of sitting with the sick, of keeping watch, of not filling the air, is this turn. Do not rush to be useful. Be there.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is amathambo, maphakathi, ngakwesokudla, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 櫟 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Sit with a person who is not ready to speak. Let ten minutes pass without fixing them.

z: 櫢 amathambo, maphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
The wisdom shared by many houses is hard: do not let the sun go down on a break you are willing to heal, and do not call it healing if you are only waiting to retell it.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is amathambo, maphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 櫢 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Decide, and say, whether the person is still a member. Do not leave them in a fog.

z: 櫤 amathambo, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Children grieve in strange hours and then ask for ordinary things. Both are grief. Answer the ordinary thing. Do not make them perform a sadness you can recognize.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is amathambo, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 櫤 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Leave the empty place unspoken-of only if the grieving person wishes it. Otherwise, speak the name.

z: 櫧 amathambo, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
A child who sees an adult look again, after a bad day, learns that a bad day is not a verdict. This is worth more than any optimism you could announce.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is amathambo, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 櫧 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Set one place at the table that despair said was pointless. Eat there.

z: 櫨 amathambo, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokudla
line:
Children are the usual casualties of a score kept between adults. They did not agree to carry it. Mercy toward the person you resent is also protection of the child.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is amathambo, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokudla, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 櫨 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: If a child is carrying a feud that belongs to adults, take it back. Say that it is not theirs.

z: 櫪 amathambo, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Siblings fight because they share a roof and a hunger. The fight is not the failure. The failure is when the stronger one discovers a liking for the smaller one's fear. Protection refuses that discovery.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is amathambo, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 櫪 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Teach the strong child to stand in front of the smaller one. That is anger, turned, and it can be learned young.

z: 櫬 amathambo, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Brothers and sisters are the first public. What you do to be admired at home becomes the way they will treat their own children. Give them a dignity they can copy.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is amathambo, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 櫬 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Praise a person in the house for a quality you do not share. Do not add a correction.

z: 櫱 amathambo, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
The teachings that endured all warn the eye. They also bless the eye that rejoices. Rejoicing is not a mood. It is a decision made again each time the other person shines.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is amathambo, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 櫱 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: When a sibling is praised, add one true sentence of your own. Do not balance it with your own news.

z: 櫲 amathambo, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla
line:
Fear of the future makes a house small. Courage does not enlarge the future. It keeps today's people inside the house while the future remains unknown.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is amathambo, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 櫲 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Stay until the scared person is breathing slowly. Do not explain the dark away before you have sat in it.

z: 櫳 amathambo, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Psychology is simple here. The closed hand teaches the body that the world is about to run out. The open hand teaches it that tomorrow includes other people.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is amathambo, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 櫳 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Pass the best portion first. The first piece teaches the house what it is.

z: 櫺 amathambo, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Gossip is how a house talks about its own when they have left the room. Healing speech waits until they are back, and then says the hard thing to the face, cleanly.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is amathambo, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 櫺 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Speak the true sentence. Keep the second one, the one that only wanted to win.

z: 櫻 amathambo, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Across the old writings, the warning against scoffing is constant. A scoffer cannot be taught, and a house that scoffs cannot learn itself.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is amathambo, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 櫻 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Thank a person for a labor you have stopped seeing. Thank the labor, not their temperament.

z: 櫽 amathambo, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
Some truths are not ready for speech. Presence holds them without using them as a weapon. A weaponized silence is still a weapon.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is amathambo, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 櫽 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Put the glowing thing in another room. Sit where you can be seen. You do not have to perform a talk.

z: 欄 amathambo, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
A child who watches a break become a lifelong trial learns that love is a court. A child who watches a break become a mended bowl learns that love can survive its own failure.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is amathambo, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 欄 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Name the break once, without extra charges. Then do one small trustworthy thing, and repeat it tomorrow.

z: 欅 amathambo, maphakathi eduze, kakhulu
line:
Compassion is grief that has recognized itself in another body and does not hurry it. Hurry is fear. The unhurried hour is the gift.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is amathambo, maphakathi eduze, kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 欅 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Do not hurry a grieving person into cheer. Let the absent name be said.

z: 權 umlenze, ithambo lomlenze olukhulu, ithambo lomlenze oluncane, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
The sciences of a lasting household call this resilience. The older word is faithfulness. It does not deny the dark. It refuses to let the dark be the only speaker.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is umlenze, ithambo lomlenze olukhulu, ithambo lomlenze oluncane, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 權 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Make one plan for tomorrow small enough that both of you can keep it.

z: 欋 umlenze, ithambo lomlenze olukhulu, ithambo lomlenze oluncane, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Many sacred traditions, in different grammars, say the same hard thing: the injury stops when someone declines to pass it on. This is not weakness. It is the end of a chain.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is umlenze, ithambo lomlenze olukhulu, ithambo lomlenze oluncane, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 欋 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Leave one cut unanswered today. Do not announce the leaving.

z: 欏 umlenze, ithambo lomlenze olukhulu, ithambo lomlenze oluncane, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
At the table, anger wants the last word. The last word is rarely food. Let the sentence end before it becomes the story the children will tell about this house.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is umlenze, ithambo lomlenze olukhulu, ithambo lomlenze oluncane, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 欏 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Before the second loud sentence, step into the doorway, not toward the person. Let the heat guard the house from outside.

z: 欐 umlenze, ithambo lomlenze olukhulu, ithambo lomlenze oluncane, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
The guest at the table is a test you did not schedule. If your worth requires the guest to be less clever, less beautiful, less faithful, your worth is a costume. Take it off.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is umlenze, ithambo lomlenze olukhulu, ithambo lomlenze oluncane, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 欐 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Admit one small wrong without a speech about your intentions. Stop when the admission is complete.

z: 欑 umlenze, ithambo lomlenze olukhulu, ithambo lomlenze oluncane, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
What you wish were yours, name it exactly, in the hearing of the person who has it. Then do not reach. The naming is the confession. The not-reaching is the turn.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is umlenze, ithambo lomlenze olukhulu, ithambo lomlenze oluncane, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 欑 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Clap, or thank, before you comment. Let the first sound from you be glad.

z: 欒 umlenze, ithambo lomlenze olukhulu, ithambo lomlenze oluncane, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Name the loss you are counting. Often it is a person in the room, not a disaster outside. Then put your body beside that person. That is the whole practice.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is umlenze, ithambo lomlenze olukhulu, ithambo lomlenze oluncane, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 欒 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Tell the truth you have been saving, and remain in the room after it is told.

z: 欖 umlenze, ithambo lomlenze olukhulu, ithambo lomlenze oluncane, phezulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
Give before you calculate whether you will be thanked. Thanks are not the food. If you require them, you have made a trade, and a trade is not yet a family.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is umlenze, ithambo lomlenze olukhulu, ithambo lomlenze oluncane, phezulu, ngakwesokudla, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 欖 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Put one thing you were keeping back into the middle of the table.

z: 欗 umlenze, ithambo lomlenze olukhulu, ithambo lomlenze oluncane, phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Wisdom is not silence forever. There is a time to speak. The test is whether the words can be repeated in front of the person, and still be a kindness.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is umlenze, ithambo lomlenze olukhulu, ithambo lomlenze oluncane, phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 欗 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Say the hard thing to the face, once, cleanly, with no audience.

z: 欛 umlenze, ithambo lomlenze olukhulu, ithambo lomlenze oluncane, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Look at the work you have stopped seeing. Name it. The naming is not flattery. It is the return of sight, and sight is the turn.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is umlenze, ithambo lomlenze olukhulu, ithambo lomlenze oluncane, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 欛 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Remove the sneer from a sentence and speak it again. Notice how much of it was only the sneer.

z: 欝 umlenze, ithambo lomlenze olukhulu, ithambo lomlenze oluncane, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Put the glowing thing in another room. Sit where you can be seen. You do not have to be interesting. You do have to be in the house.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is umlenze, ithambo lomlenze olukhulu, ithambo lomlenze oluncane, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 欝 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Sit with a person who is not ready to speak. Let ten minutes pass without fixing them.

z: 欞 umlenze, ithambo lomlenze olukhulu, ithambo lomlenze oluncane, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla
line:
Accountability is the first half. Without it, forgiveness is a fog. The one who broke the trust says what was done, without a speech about why it was almost justified.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is umlenze, ithambo lomlenze olukhulu, ithambo lomlenze oluncane, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 欞 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Eat together once without retelling the wound. Let the meal be only a meal.

z: 欟 umlenze, ithambo lomlenze olukhulu, ithambo lomlenze oluncane, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
The oldest writings are full of lament, not because lament is holy by itself, but because love that cannot lament becomes hard. Let the house be soft enough to cry.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is umlenze, ithambo lomlenze olukhulu, ithambo lomlenze oluncane, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 欟 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Answer the ordinary request of a grieving child. Do not make them perform a sadness you recognize.

z: 欠 umlenze, ithambo lomlenze olukhulu, ithambo lomlenze oluncane, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Despair often tells the truth about pain and then adds a lie about forever. Keep the truth. Decline the forever. Forever is not a fact available to a person at a window.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is umlenze, ithambo lomlenze olukhulu, ithambo lomlenze oluncane, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 欠 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Decline the word forever. Keep the true sentence about the pain, and stop before the lie.

z: 次 umlenze, ithambo lomlenze olukhulu, ithambo lomlenze oluncane, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Accountability remains. Mercy is not the cancellation of truth. It is the decision that truth will not be used as a knife at breakfast for the next twenty years.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is umlenze, ithambo lomlenze olukhulu, ithambo lomlenze oluncane, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 次 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Tell the truth of the wrong once, to the person, and then do not serve it at breakfast.

z: 欣 umlenze, ithambo lomlenze olukhulu, ithambo lomlenze oluncane, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
An elder who has turned anger into protection does not become mild. The wall is still warm. What changes is the face it turns toward. It faces the street, not the cradle.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is umlenze, ithambo lomlenze olukhulu, ithambo lomlenze oluncane, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 欣 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Teach the strong child to stand in front of the smaller one. That is anger, turned, and it can be learned young.

z: 欧 umlenze, ithambo lomlenze olukhulu, ithambo lomlenze oluncane, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
An elder's dignity is not the right to be obeyed in every small thing. It is the right to be respected while still listening. The listening is what makes the respect true.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is umlenze, ithambo lomlenze olukhulu, ithambo lomlenze oluncane, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 欧 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Praise a person in the house for a quality you do not share. Do not add a correction.

z: 欬 umlenze, ithambo lomlenze olukhulu, ithambo lomlenze oluncane, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Across generations, envy of the young is fear of being finished. Admiration of the young is how an elder stays in the story without owning it.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is umlenze, ithambo lomlenze olukhulu, ithambo lomlenze oluncane, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 欬 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: When a sibling is praised, add one true sentence of your own. Do not balance it with your own news.

z: 欯 umlenze, ithambo lomlenze olukhulu, ithambo lomlenze oluncane, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
An elder who has been afraid and stayed is a better teacher than an elder who claims never to have shaken. The shaking, survived, is the lesson.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is umlenze, ithambo lomlenze olukhulu, ithambo lomlenze oluncane, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 欯 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Name the person you are afraid of losing, and spend the next hour near them without a speech.

z: 欲 umlenze, ithambo lomlenze olukhulu, ithambo lomlenze oluncane, maphakathi, ngakwesokudla
line:
An elder who gives the best piece away is not being careless with the future. The elder is showing the future how a house continues.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is umlenze, ithambo lomlenze olukhulu, ithambo lomlenze oluncane, maphakathi, ngakwesokudla, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 欲 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Give a thing away that you still like. Do not wait until you are tired of it.

z: 欵 umlenze, ithambo lomlenze olukhulu, ithambo lomlenze oluncane, maphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
An elder's stories are a kind of speech that builds or bends a family. Tell the story in which people are repaired. The other story will tell itself.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is umlenze, ithambo lomlenze olukhulu, ithambo lomlenze oluncane, maphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 欵 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Tell one story tonight in which a person in this house is repaired, not mocked.

z: 欷 umlenze, ithambo lomlenze olukhulu, ithambo lomlenze oluncane, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
An elder who still notices the small faithfulness in the house is a gift to the young. The young become what is noticed.

This is the work of an elder with the young. What you are seeing is umlenze, ithambo lomlenze olukhulu, ithambo lomlenze oluncane, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu, kept. The turn is not a fog laid over it. 欷 names the page. The page still shows a body that can hold, walk, and stay.
practice: Ask to be shown a skill you had decided was beneath you. Watch the whole way through.
